title: Medium Problems
definition: Problems requiring two concepts combined, or optimizing a brute-force approach. E.g., LRU Cache, 3Sum, Number of Islands. The most common interview difficulty.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Medium Problems.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Medium Problems to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Medium Problems into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Medium Problems.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Medium Problems from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
